mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscles to the skeleton was most worthwhile because it brought the separate pieces together and showed how their pulls move the joint.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones at the elbow was fairly predictable, although the picture helped explain the joint.

surprise.text: I was surprised that both muscles pull, with their positions making the elbow move in opposite directions.

arbitrary.text: I needed the compatibility hint to learn that supporting connective tissue would help make muscle bundles; its role wasn't clear to me beforehand. The result explained the supporting tissue and tendon ends.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because seeing separate tissues put together into a working arm made me curious about how other body systems fit together.
